title: Physical Cross-Modal Masked Autoencoding for Seismic-to-Well Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.36193v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning from scientific measurements often requires aligning modalities with different spatial support and resolution. Subsurface characterization is an extreme dense-sparse problem in which 3D seismic provides volumetric but indirect measurements and well logs provide high-resolution 1D measurements at sparse borehole locations. We introduce a physically grounded cross-modal masked autoencoder (CM-MAE) for seismic-to-well representation learning. The model jointly tokenizes seismic volumes and well-log depth patches, embeds both modalities in continuous physical coordinates using four-axis rotary position embeddings, and reconstructs masked targets with a cross-modal decoder. Sparse Mixture-of-Experts layers provide modality-specific capacity while dense attention allows information exchange between modalities. Pretraining uses 23 seismic volumes covering approximately 178,000 square km across U.S. offshore and onshore basins, together

translated_title: 面向地震-测井表示学习的物理跨模态掩码自编码
translated_abstract: 从科学测量中学习往往需要对齐具有不同空间支撑范围和分辨率的模态。地下表征是一个极端的稠密-稀疏问题：三维地震提供体积化但间接的测量，而测井曲线则在稀疏的井位处提供高分辨率的一维测量。我们提出了一种具有物理基础的跨模态掩码自编码器（CM-MAE），用于地震到测井的表示学习。该模型将地震体和测井深度片段共同进行标记化，使用四轴旋转位置嵌入将两种模态嵌入到连续的物理坐标中，并通过跨模态解码器重建被掩码的目标。稀疏混合专家层提供特定模态的处理容量，同时稠密注意力机制实现了模态之间的信息交换。预训练使用了覆盖美国近海和陆上盆地约178,000平方公里的23个地震体数据，以及（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 提出了一种物理基础的跨模态掩码自编码器（CM-MAE），通过四轴旋转位置嵌入、稀疏混合专家层和跨模态解码器，在约17.8万平方公里的美国海陆盆地地震数据上预训练，实现了地震体数据与稀疏测井数据之间的表示学习。
en_tdlr: A physically grounded cross-modal masked autoencoder (CM-MAE) with four-axis rotary position embeddings, sparse Mixture-of-Experts layers, and a cross-modal decoder enables seismic-to-well representation learning, pretrained on 23 seismic volumes covering approximately 178,000 square km across U.S. offshore and onshore basins.
